newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize down on supply, Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize down on supply, Chicago.

text.p: Argentine cash maize was lower in good volume trade midsession at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with plentiful harvest supply and lower CBOT prices pushing values down, traders said.

The FAS elevator maize price in Buenos Aires lost $3 to $109. Buenos Aires soybeans slipped $4 to $306 in hearty volume trade, with the market following Chicago down. Buenos Aires spot sunflower seed was unchanged at $228 in moderate volume, with the market underpinned by good demand for oil abroad. Spot Bahia Blanca wheat was unchanged at $150 in slow end-of-season trade.
